mission: Invent the future of government infrastructure through relentless automation, design elegance, and championship-level operational excellence.
core_principles: Immutable infrastructure (everything in Git, cattle not pets)
Telemetry and observability at every layer

executives.key_message: Own total visibility, agility, and trust. With TerraFusion, lead your county into a future where government infrastructure never fails and always innovates.

it_ops.key_message: Every deploy is as precise as a Tesla assembly robot. Pipelines self-test, auto-heal, and ship code at the speed of progress. Security, reliability, and automation are default—not afterthoughts.

county_staff.key_message: Experience workflows as effortless as iPhone UX and as dependable as Autopilot. TerraFusion turns complexity into clarity, so you can focus on serving the community.

citizens.key_message: Enjoy government services that are faster, simpler, and always available—your county’s digital infrastructure is now as advanced as any Fortune 500.

devops_manifesto: If something is important enough, even if the odds are against you, you should still do it. We build government infrastructure like Tesla builds cars and SpaceX launches rockets: self-healing, zero-downtime, auditable, and ready for infinite scale.

iac_example.philosophy: Everything is code: versioned, reproducible, and automated.

requirements: Fail fast on security or quality gates

container_architecture.healthchecks: Every container exposes a /health endpoint; readiness/liveness probes on K8s
container_architecture.resource_limits: CPU/memory precisely defined, with autoscaling enabled

kubernetes.deployment: Multi-AZ, anti-affinity, rolling updates, strict RBAC, Istio mTLS, automated scaling
kubernetes.monitoring: Prometheus and Grafana for full telemetry; every metric matters

security.model: Zero-trust, mTLS everywhere, network micro-segmentation, Vault-integrated secrets, mandatory audit logging
security.testing: Automated SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, quarterly pen tests

database.ha: Multi-AZ with daily encrypted backups, point-in-time restore, automated failover
database.compliance: Audit trails on all DML, role-based access control, retention policies

observability.alerting: Critical alerts escalate to ops with PagerDuty or equivalent

deployment_strategy: Progressive (canary) with auto-analysis, instant rollback, traffic splitting (Argo Rollouts or equivalent)
quality_standards: No compromises: four nines uptime, championship test coverage, measured business outcomes
Every deployment is observable, reversible, and forensically logged

sample_microcopy.error: Something went wrong—autonomous recovery is in progress.
